description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeDao for accessing customer attribute data in a database, using QueryDSL and JPA within a Spring repository.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerAttribute, providing methods to retrieve customer attribute data based on various criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by its ID, fetching related customer, option, and description data.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by merchant store, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a specific customer within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option ID.
